_meta.description: Explicit verb metadata overrides. Takes precedence over heuristic inference in lib/verb-metadata.ts.

audit.side_effects: Some audit subcommands (a11y, perf, mobile) trigger Lighthouse scans that consume CPU and network. Classify as read but note resource cost.

clone.side_effects: Creates a full company from template (KB entries, pages, services). Idempotent only if the company already exists.

import.side_effects: Parses external HTML/data and writes to KB or pages. May create many entities in a single call.
